capabilities: Download notes one-way from inBox cloud storage via WebDAV or S3
Sync incrementally based on ETag and mtime on a configurable interval
Download images, videos, recordings, and attachments into an assets folder
Extract hierarchical tags and write YAML frontmatter including the box field
Organize notes into per-box folders that rename or empty automatically
disambiguation: Not a two-way sync; it only downloads inBox notes into the vault and never uploads edits, deletions, or new notes.
extras: Not yet in the official community plugin directory (review pending), so the README recommends installing via BRAT; the README is written entirely in Chinese.
problem: Users who collect notes in the inBox app have no built-in way to pull those notes, media, and tags into their Obsidian vault.

relations.evidence: inBox 是收集箱，编辑/删除交给桌面端做。插件只读云端

summary: One-way sync that downloads notes from the inBox app to an Obsidian vault via WebDAV or S3-compatible storage, including attachments and tags.
